query:
EVALUATE
ROW(
  "Active 0-1d", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(IncidentsAllFields[incidentid]), IncidentsAllFields[statuscodename] IN {"Neu","In Progress","In Wartezustand"}, IncidentsAllFields[caseage] < 1440),
  "Active 1-3d", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(IncidentsAllFields[incidentid]), IncidentsAllFields[statuscodename] IN {"Neu","In Progress","In Wartezustand"}, IncidentsAllFields[caseage] >= 1440, IncidentsAllFields[caseage] < 4320),
  "Active 3-7d", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(IncidentsAllFields[incidentid]), IncidentsAllFields[statuscodename] IN {"Neu","In Progress","In Wartezustand"}, IncidentsAllFields[caseage] >= 4320, IncidentsAllFields[caseage] < 10080),
  "Active 7-30d", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(IncidentsAllFields[incidentid]), IncidentsAllFields[statuscodename] IN {"Neu","In Progress","In Wartezustand"}, IncidentsAllFields[caseage] >= 10080, IncidentsAllFields[caseage] < 43200),
  "Active 30d+", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(IncidentsAllFields[incidentid]), IncidentsAllFields[statuscodename] IN {"Neu","In Progress","In Wartezustand"}, IncidentsAllFields[caseage] >= 43200),
  "MaxActiveAgeDays", CALCULATE(MAX(IncidentsAllFields[caseage]) / 1440, IncidentsAllFields[statuscodename] IN {"Neu","In Progress","In Wartezustand"})
)
